name: DACH e-commerce baseline
description: Ten pre- and post-purchase intents. Costs, delivery speed, returns policy and payment methods are among the top checkout-abandonment reasons in Baymard Institute research; invoice payment (Kauf auf Rechnung) is a DACH-specific expectation. Keywords are German and English because the sites are mostly German-language.

tasks.task: How many days do I have to return an item?
Are returns free, or do I have to pay for return shipping?
How much does shipping cost, and from what order value is it free?
How long does standard delivery take?
Which countries do you deliver to?
Which payment methods do you accept?
Can I pay by invoice (Kauf auf Rechnung)?
How can I reach customer service, and when are they available?
How do I track my order?
How long is the warranty, and how do I make a warranty claim?
